definitions.gloss: counter for letters, documents, and written communications
definitions.explanation: Used to count pieces of mail, official documents, and written communications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{3通|さんつう}⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{応募書類|おうぼしょるい}→応募書類：22928_ouboshorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{2通|につう}⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Two copies of the application documents are required.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{2通|につう}⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、{1通|いっつう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: Make two copies of the contract and give one to the other party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{何十|なんじゅっ}→何十：noentry⟧{通|つう}⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}かなければならない→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: At year-end, I have to write dozens of New Year's cards every year.

notes:
COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧{通|つう} (1 letter)
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{通|つう} (2 letters)
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{通|つう} (3 letters)
- ⟦{何|なん}→何：03100_nan⟧{通|つう} (how many letters)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧ (letters)
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧ (emails)
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ (documents)
- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧ (resumes)
- ⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧ (applications)

NOTE: This counter emphasizes the 'through/communication' aspect (⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧ = to communicate). Different from ⟦{枚|まい}→枚：00650_mai⟧ which counts flat objects by their physical form.
